source:
@@U03123@@
Yes, well, but not to digress— the gr in griffin is surely a sound that pleases you? An honorific title!

@@U03125@@
(Snarling as before, and throughout.)

@@U03126@@
Of course! The affinity’s proven; often condemned, to be sure, but more often praised. A griffin grips, a griffin grabs, whether girls or gold or coronets. Dame Fortune is gracious to him who grabs.

@@U03128@@
You speak of gold. We'd gathered quite a hoard and stashed it in all kinds of secret caves and hollows. But they smelled it out, those Arimasps, and carried it off we don't know where. Look at them over there, laughing at us.

@@U03130@@
Rest easy, we'll make them confess.

@@U03132@@
Not tonight you won't! Tonight we celebrate carnival! And by tomorrow we'll have run through it all. This time we'll get away with it.

@@U03134@@
(Has sat down between the 斯芬克斯们.)

@@U03135@@
How easy I find it to be at home here! I understand every one of you!

@@U03137@@
We whisper our ghostly sounds, which you then give body to. For now your name will do, until we know you better.
translation:
@@U03123@@
是的，好吧，但别离题了——格里芬中的 gr 肯定是一种让你高兴的声音？一个尊称！

@@U03125@@
（一如既往地咆哮，自始至终。）

@@U03126@@
当然！亲和力已得到证实；当然，经常受到谴责，但更多时候受到赞扬。狮鹫抓握，狮鹫抓握，无论是女孩、黄金还是皇冠。命运女神对抢夺的人很仁慈。

@@U03128@@
你说的是黄金。我们收集了相当多的宝藏，并将其藏在各种秘密的洞穴和洞穴中。但他们，那些阿里马斯人，嗅到了它的味道，然后把它带到了我们不知道去哪儿的地方。看看他们那边，正在嘲笑我们。

@@U03130@@
放心吧，我们会让他们招供的。

@@U03132@@
今晚你不会的！今晚我们庆祝狂欢节！到明天我们就会完成这一切。这次我们就可以侥幸逃脱了。

@@U03134@@
（坐在斯芬克斯夫妇中间。）

@@U03135@@
我发现在这里是多么轻松的事啊！我理解你们每一个人！

@@U03137@@
我们低声说出幽灵般的声音，然后你将其赋予身体。现在你的名字就可以了，直到我们更了解你为止。
